data.label: Fast
data.note:
Five copies of the A4 lattice, each ⅕ further along the diagonal,
one point of each: the closest corner of the simplex the position
is in, moving one axis further per copy.

data.label: First copy
data.note:
The copy sure to have a point in the cell's base simplex,
from how far along the diagonal the position is.

data.label: Step
data.note:
The axis the position is furthest along (the first on a tie),
stepped once it's past the simplex's far face.

data.label: Next copy
data.note:
⅕ further along the diagonal; past the first copy the
cell's corner falls one step back.

data.label: Smooth
data.note:
The A4* lattice's points within reach, from a table of those around
a cell whose coordinates are sorted, the position's sorted the same way.

data.label: Symmetry
data.note:
Past the cell's middle diagonal, mirrored through its centre,
so the coordinates add up to at most 2.

data.label: Ranks
data.note:
Each axis's rank among the coordinates, largest first (the first
axis on a tie), and which axis has each rank.
